method: Explicit regional cell inventories, visually compared with Shepherd 1911 pp.138–139, medieval territorial descriptions and Baltic institutional histories. The envelope is an audit boundary, never a political border. The supplied HTML was a candidate finder only; its late dates and conflation of Russian principalities were not adopted.
